selection: uniform per-day quota, then deterministic seed-7 global cap; label magnitude and sign unused
primary_statistic: equal-stock then equal-date mean of stock/day Spearman IC on paired original-event endpoints
primary_comparison: S0 minus dev-selected best of B0/B1
uncertainty: paired five-trading-day date-block bootstrap with all stocks carried together; seeds separate
training_budget: Old-data GPU pilot <=4 GPU-hours and total <=24 GPU-hours; CPU time and core-hours separately reported. Stop training if configured maximum epochs exhausted with nonconverged curves; do not call it a simple-model win.
independent_confirmation: None qualified; no existing 2017 date is a new sealed final.
